name: Fauvism / Wild Colour / Cut-Paper Planes
summary: Early-modernist gallery surface: warm cream canvas, wild arbitrary red/orange/yellow/green/blue set down as flat opaque planes inside 3px ink contours, simplified silhouettes, and depth made from a second colour block instead of a shadow.
whenToUse: When the user asks for Fauvism, Matisse or Derain, a wild-colour fine-art look, flat bold colour planes, cut-paper composition, a gallery or exhibition or museum site, poster-like flat colour, or an expressive painterly design system that is decorative without being skeuomorphic.
rules: Colour is arbitrary, never literal: a plane takes the hue that sings against its neighbour — a wall can be red, a field blue-green — but the palette never leaves the six Fauve hues plus cream and ink.
One idea per plane: every block is a single colour at full opacity, flat and unmodulated. No gradients inside a shape, no alpha tints, no two shades of one hue layered as if they were light.
Draw the contour: every plane and every interactive element carries the same 3px #221e1b ink stroke, so colour sits inside a drawn line the way gouache sits inside a charcoal outline.

Depth is a second plane, not a shadow: elevation is an offset colour rectangle behind the surface (transform: translate(10px, 10px), 3px ink border) or a 3px ink rule — box-shadow stays none and nothing in the system blurs.
Keep the cream canvas #f5efe2 exposed and let colour take at most about 40% of the viewport; 32–48px margins and one dominant plane per screen make the colour look placed rather than poured.

Set display copy in Fredoka 700 at 24px and up with tracking tightened to -0.01em, body copy in Montserrat 400/500 at 17–18px/1.6, and reserve IBM Plex Mono for figures, dates, dimensions, and catalogue numbers.
Simplify the form to its loudest readable silhouette — circle, arc, wedge, block — and keep decorative cut-paper shapes in the margins where they carry no words.
Move with confident, slow hands: 160–480ms on cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1), planes wiping in with clip-path or cross-fading in place. No bounce, no spring overshoot, no infinite shimmer.
Stay evocation-only: borrow palette logic, flatness, and decorative rhythm from Fauvism — never a painting, poster, signature, or museum image.

componentRecipes.select: A flat-color dropdown: trigger = IBM Plex Mono 16px field (background:#fbf6ec;border:3px solid #221e1b;border-radius:6px;padding:13px 16px) with a red '▾'; the open list is a #fbf6ec panel where the selected row fills #f2c14e with a 3px #221e1b border and a 6px ink left bar; hover shows only a 3px #26408b border; selection always outranks hover.
componentRecipes.checkbox: A 26px square plane: background:#fbf6ec;border:3px solid #221e1b;border-radius:6px; checked = 12px #d7263d block inside; radio = 10px #26408b dot; label = Montserrat 16px #221e1b with 'On'/'Off'; focus-visible = 3px #26408b outline at 3px offset; never a soft shadow.
componentRecipes.badge: A flat chip: display:inline-flex;gap:8px;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:6px;border:3px solid #221e1b;background:#fbf6ec;color:#221e1b;font:600 14px/1.2 'Fredoka'; leading 10px square in the role color (#2a9d8f/#f2c14e/#a4161a/#26408b) plus the word; no gradients, no glow.
componentRecipes.avatar: A 40px round tile: background:#fbf6ec;border:3px solid #221e1b;border-radius:6px;color:#221e1b;font:700 16px 'Fredoka'; initials or a flat silhouette glyph; image avatars get a 3px ink contour and 6px radius.
componentRecipes.nav: A flat rail: items = Fredoka 600 17px #221e1b, padding 12px 18px, border 3px transparent, border-radius 6px; hover = 3px #26408b border only; active = #f2c14e fill with a 3px #221e1b border and a 6px ink left bar; section headers = Montserrat 700 12px uppercase #6f6a63; selection outranks hover.
componentRecipes.table: A gouache grid: header = Montserrat 700 13px uppercase #221e1b over a 3px #221e1b rule; body rows = Montserrat 16px #221e1b separated by 3px #6f6a63 rules; hover = #26408b border around the row, selected row = #f2c14e fill with a 3px ink contour and a 6px left bar; radius 6px.
componentRecipes.dialog: An offset-plane modal: panel recipe with a ::before color plane (translate(10px,10px), 3px ink border); scrim = color-mix(in srgb, var(--overlay) 40%, transparent); title = Fredoka 700 Title Case, body = Montserrat; actions = red primary + cream secondary with a blue contour; entrance is a 280ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) plane wipe.
componentRecipes.toast: A bottom-right plane: background:#fbf6ec;border:3px solid #221e1b;border-radius:6px;padding:12px 16px;font:14px/1.4 'Montserrat'; leading 10px square in the role color (#2a9d8f/#f2c14e/#a4161a) plus the word (Saved, Unsaved, Error); auto-dismisses with a 280ms wipe; reduced motion keeps it static.
componentRecipes.code: A monospace block: background:#fbf6ec;border:3px solid #221e1b;border-radius:6px;padding:16px;font:14px/1.6 'IBM Plex Mono';color:#221e1b; preserve whitespace; comments #6f6a63, strings #d7263d, values #26408b; no syntax gradients, and the block keeps the blue focus ring.
componentRecipes.empty: A centred panel with a flat cut-paper glyph (a circle or arc) above one Montserrat message ('The canvas is empty.') and a single red CTA; the glyph is aria-hidden and the state is written in words.
componentRecipes.panel: background: #fbf6ec; border: 3px solid #221e1b; border-radius: 6px; padding: 32px; color: #221e1b; box-shadow: none; position: relative; — depth is a ::before plane: content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; transform: translate(10px, 10px); background: #f2c14e; border: 3px solid #221e1b; border-radius: inherit; z-index: -1; swap the plane colour by role (#26408b informational, #d7263d primary, #2a9d8f success) and allow exactly one plane per panel; a full-bleed 12px colour band across the panel's top edge may carry the section hue; headings inside are Fredoka 700 26px/1.15 Title Case in #221e1b, and below 640px the offset plane drops to 6px and loses its border so it never crowds the text.
componentRecipes.button: font: 700 17px/1 'Fredoka', 'Montserrat', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; padding: 15px 28px; border-radius: 6px; background: #d7263d; color: #f5efe2; border: 3px solid #221e1b; box-shadow: none; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), background-color 160ms linear; :hover { background: #b91c31; transform: translate(-2px, -2px); } :active { transform: translate(1px, 1px); } :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #26408b; outline-offset: 3px; } — secondary: background #f5efe2, color #221e1b, border 3px solid #26408b, hover fills #26408b with cream text; quiet/tertiary: no fill, 3px ink underline at 4px offset that thickens to 5px on hover; disabled: background #e3d8c3, color #6f6a63, border-color #6f6a63, no transform and no hover.
componentRecipes.input: font: 16px/1.6 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: #221e1b; background: #fbf6ec; border: 3px solid #221e1b; border-radius: 6px; padding: 13px 16px; box-shadow: none; caret-color: #d7263d; :placeholder { color: #6f6a63; font: 400 16px 'Montserrat', system-ui, sans-serif; } :focus { border-color: #26408b; outline: 3px solid #26408b; outline-offset: 2px; background: #fffdf7; } — the 3px stroke never thins on focus; invalid state keeps the 3px weight, sets border-color #a4161a and adds a 16px Montserrat sentence below in #a4161a ('That is not a number we can use.'), so the error never rests on colour alone; every field carries a Montserrat 600 14px ink label above it instead of using the placeholder as the label.
componentRecipes.statusbar: height: 52px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 32px; padding: 0 24px; background: #26408b; color: #f5efe2; border-top: 3px solid #221e1b; border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0; font: 13px/1.4 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.04em; segments are split by border-left: 3px solid rgba(245,239,226,.45) and each reads label-then-value ('PLANES 04', 'PIGMENT 06'); the live value is #f2c14e (5.7:1 on the blue), and state is a 10px colour square plus a cream word ('Saved', 'Unsaved', 'Error') — never colour alone; the trailing slot holds one cream-outlined secondary button at 40px height.
componentRecipes.menu: no bullets, 4px gap, rows are flat planes rather than boxes: item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 12px 18px; font: 600 17px/1.3 'Fredoka', 'Montserrat', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #221e1b; background: transparent; border: 3px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; } selected row fills #f2c14e with a 3px #221e1b border and a 6px ink bar flush to its left edge; hover shows only the 3px #26408b border and no fill, so selection always outranks hover; section headers are Montserrat 700 12px uppercase at letter-spacing 0.14em in #6f6a63 with no stroke; keep one column of cream gutter beside the rail so colour never presses against the page edge.
componentRecipes.plane: the signature block: position: relative; background: #f5efe2; border: 3px solid #221e1b; border-radius: 6px; a solid second-hue rectangle sits either behind it (::before, transform: translate(10px, 10px)) or beside it as a full-height 8px–48px vertical band; planes may bleed past the container edge by up to 32px and may be clipped by an organic border-radius (64px 6px 64px 6px) when the shape is decorative; a plane never sits behind running text without first clearing to #fbf6ec, and two planes never overlap a third colour except where a contour separates them.

copywriting.voice: Vivid and plain-spoken, like a confident studio hand talking across the room: short declarative sentences, one bright modifier each, and colour words used as verbs ('paint the panel red', 'strip it back to cream'). Numbers are quoted like a wall label — height, year, count — and the reader is treated as someone who came to look, not to be lectured. Warm, opinionated, never precious, and never art-history name-dropping for its own sake.

case.commands: sentence case imperative ('Paint the plane', 'Set the figure down')

avoid: deadpan system errors ('Invalid input.', 'An error occurred', 'Something went wrong')
art-history jargon dumps and wall-text padding that explains the painting instead of the page
apologetic loading copy ('Sorry, just a moment') and hedges ('maybe', 'perhaps', 'might want to')
emoji, and dialogue or slogans lifted from any existing artwork or exhibition
stacked punctuation (!!!, ???) and all-caps sentences longer than three words
titles of real paintings cited as if the interface owned them

do: Choose each plane's colour by what it does to its neighbour, not by what the object is — red beside green, blue under orange — and keep every fill at full opacity.
Wrap every shape in the same 3px #221e1b ink contour so blocks read as drawn and cut out rather than rendered.
Build depth from an offset colour plane or a 3px ink rule; leave box-shadow at none and never blur an edge.
Leave the cream ground #f5efe2 plainly visible between planes, and give the composition 32–48px margins plus one dominant block per screen.
Set headings in Fredoka 700 Title Case from 24px up with -0.01em tracking and body in Montserrat 400/500 at 17–18px/1.6; keep IBM Plex Mono for figures and catalogue data only.
Simplify every motif to one silhouette — a circle for a sun or fruit, an arc for a back or a wave, a wedge for a leaf, a block for a wall — so the shape survives at 24px.
Animate one plane at a time: a clip-path wipe or an in-place cross-fade over 160–480ms, settled on cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1), then hold still.
Pair every colour-coded state with a word, and put ink or cream text on a plane only where the measured contrast allows it.
dont: No real artworks: no painting, poster, drawing, signature, logo, or museum photograph, and no traced copy of a Fauvist composition — evocation through palette, flatness, and layout only.
No gradients, alpha washes, glassmorphism, backdrop-blur, or tinted overlays; a plane is one opaque colour inside one ink line.
No box-shadows, no blurred or glowing depth, no bevels, no embossing, no inner highlights — any soft edge reads as rendered UI and kills the gouache flatness.
No literal colour: never make a sky blue just because it is a sky, and never reduce the palette to a pastel or muted scheme.
No hairline borders, pill buttons, or 1px dividers — the smallest line weight in the system is 3px ink, and 6px is the only radius.
No more than one second colour in a single component (the offset plane), and no third hue used as decoration inside it.
No spring bounce, infinite shimmer, parallax drift, or slow ease-in-out fades over 480ms, and no texture overlays that imitate canvas or paper grain at scale.
accessibility: Ink #221e1b on cream #f5efe2 is roughly 14.6:1 and blue #26408b on cream about 8.4:1, so those carry body copy; red #d7263d on cream measures about 4.3:1 and green #2a9d8f about 2.8:1, so red is limited to 19px-plus bold or bigger type and green to fills, contours, and large labels with ink #221e1b text on top (ink on green is about 5.1:1).
Yellow #f2c14e and orange #f46036 on cream are 1.5:1 and 2.8:1 — strictly decorative fills; any word set on them is ink #221e1b (about 10:1 on yellow), and never place cream text on either.

Fredoka stays at 20px and up for headings with 1.15–1.25 line-height, Montserrat carries all body text at 17–18px/1.6, and IBM Plex Mono never goes below 13px; widened tracking is for uppercase micro-labels only, never for paragraphs.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion: swap every plane wipe and cross-fade for an instant state change, and keep hover feedback as a border or colour shift rather than a transform so nothing slides.

Never let colour alone carry meaning — pair each plane and status square with a written label, give decorative cut-paper shapes aria-hidden with no text on them, and keep a visible 3px #26408b focus ring at 3px offset on every focusable element, including rows and links inside a selected yellow menu item.
signatureElement: The flat offset colour plane: one bold arbitrary Fauve hue set down as an opaque rectangle behind or beside the content and cut by a 3px ink contour — the block, not a shadow, is what gives the page its depth

prose.overview: This mode paints the interface as a Fauve canvas: a warm cream ground, colour chosen for its own loudness, and shapes simplified until only the silhouette is left. Every surface is a flat opaque plane inside a 3px ink contour, with depth coming from a second colour block set down behind the first rather than from any shadow. The result is decorative and confident — poster-like — while the grid underneath stays strict, so the wildness lives in hue and placement and never in sloppy alignment. It should feel like a gallery wall you are allowed to rearrange, not a painting reproduced as a skin.
prose.colors: Cream #f5efe2 is the only neutral, with cards one step lighter at #fbf6ec and ink #221e1b carrying every contour and nearly all text. Five hues do the shouting — red #d7263d as primary, blue #26408b as accent, orange #f46036, yellow #f2c14e, and green #2a9d8f — with #a4161a for hard failure and #6f6a63 for muted labels. Colour here is deliberately non-literal: it is assigned by what a plane needs beside its neighbour, not by what the object is, and each hue is used at one full-opacity value rather than as a tint series. The ramps in the palette only exist to supply a pressed or hover step; they are never stacked inside one shape to fake light.
prose.typography: Fredoka sets the voice — a bold geometric face with generous counters that holds up as flat cut-out lettering at 24px and above, tightened to -0.01em so headings read as blocks of colour-adjacent shape. Montserrat carries every sentence at 400/500 in 17–18px with 1.6 line-height, because a neutral geometric grotesque stays quiet under a loud palette instead of competing with it. IBM Plex Mono appears only where a number needs to feel measured — figure counts, dates, dimensions, catalogue numbers — and its stiffness is the point: it reads as the wall label, not the artwork. No script faces, no faux-italic, no condensed display squeezing, and uppercase only for tracked micro-labels.
prose.layout: Layout is a hung composition: a 12-column grid on a 4/8/16/32/48px spacing scale, usually carrying two or three large blocks rather than many small ones, with the dominant plane placed off-centre to leave cream breathing room around it. Margins run 32–48px and are treated as part of the picture, so colour never presses against the viewport edge; a plane may bleed up to 32px past its container, but the cream gutter beside it always survives. Sequences stack vertically on narrow screens and keep their colour bands, numbers, and contour so the rhythm of planes survives the reflow. Decorative cut-paper shapes are parked in the margins and in negative space, never behind paragraphs.
prose.elevation: There is no light model: box-shadow is none across the system, and nothing in the interface ever blurs. Elevation is a second plane — a solid colour rectangle offset by translate(10px, 10px) behind a card, or a 3px ink rule that separates two grounds — so a raised element looks glued down rather than lit. Interaction is signalled by the plane moving rather than by illumination: hover nudges the element two pixels off its plane, press sets it back flush, and the offset shrinks below 640px where space is tight. The single tolerated gradient is the optional sub-10% saffron vignette behind a hero, which may sit under text only after the type clears to #fbf6ec.
prose.shapes: Forms reduce to their loudest readable silhouette: blocks for walls and panels, circles for suns and fruit, arcs for backs and waves, wedges for leaves, and a few large organic cut-out blobs for decoration. Hard-edged elements take a 6px radius and a 3px ink contour; decorative shapes may take a pair of 64px corners so they read as scissors-cut rather than as a rounded card. Border weight is constant at 3px and is the smallest line in the system — there are no hairlines, no pills, no 1px dividers, and no icon set that imitates a modern line library. Nothing is bevelled, embossed, or given an inner highlight.
prose.components: Cards are cream panels with a 3px ink contour and one offset colour plane behind them, and the plane's hue is the card's role: blue for informational, red for primary, green for success. Buttons are ink-contoured red rectangles with cream labels that shift two pixels off their plane on hover and sit flush on press, with cream secondaries outlined in blue and quiet actions marked by a 5px ink underline. Inputs are cream wells set in IBM Plex Mono whose contour thickens into a blue focus ring and whose error state adds a written sentence rather than leaning on red alone. The status bar is a blue strip of mono label-and-value pairs with the live figure in yellow and a colour square plus a word for state, and menus are flat rows where selection paints the row yellow with an ink bar on its left edge while hover only draws a blue outline.
prose.dosDonts: Do choose colour by adjacency rather than by subject, do keep every fill flat and every shape inside a 3px ink contour, and do build depth from an offset colour plane instead of a shadow. Don't reproduce a painting, poster, or signature, don't reintroduce gradients, glass, or soft glow, and don't let the wildness leak into alignment — the palette shouts, the grid does not.
